subject.title: feat: add publisher follow controls and discovery

question: After the concrete defects and proof gap are resolved, should ClawHub adopt a permanent private publisher-follow graph and authenticated public follow API as a supported product boundary?
rationale: This adds durable private relationship data, identity-deletion obligations, and a new authenticated API contract; automated review cannot decide whether that long-term privacy and product boundary is intended.

options.title: Approve after safeguards
options.body: Accept the feature only after both identity deletion paths clean follow rows, ownership uses stable IDs, request validation is strict, public documentation is complete, and real behavior proof is supplied.

options.title: Keep the first release private
options.body: Limit the initial feature to authenticated in-app follow and discovery behavior while deferring the public API contract for separate lifecycle and privacy approval.

options.title: Decline the social graph
options.body: Do not add persistent publisher following to ClawHub and preserve any independently useful discovery fixes in a narrower contribution.

recommendation.title: Approve after safeguards
recommendation.body: Accept the feature only after both identity deletion paths clean follow rows, ownership uses stable IDs, request validation is strict, public documentation is complete, and real behavior proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current collaborator reviewer covering the exact privacy, ownership, API, and UI boundary on this head.
